Supplementary Information for Using Disk Image Related Tools on 1chipMSX

# Disk Image Related Tools
EP      .COM : FD emulate table setter for MEGA-SCSI
ESET    .COM : MEGA-SCSI setup utility
FDCOPY  .COM : Sector to Sector copy tool
FDLOAD  .COM : File to Sector convert tool
FDSAVE  .COM : Sector to File convert tool
MGLOAD  .COM : MegaROM loader for MEGA-SCSI
MGSAVE  .COM : MegaROM to File convert tool

For basic usage of these tools, please refer to the 1chipMSX user manual.

For more advanced usage, please refer to the documents included in each archive
in the \Tools\DiskImage\reference directory on the 1chipMSX accompanying CD-ROM.
